pkgmetadata.longdescription: Neomacs is a GPU-powered Emacs fork rewriting Emacs internals in Rust. This package installs it under the app-editors/emacs atom (SLOT 31-neomacs) so that Emacs dependencies resolve to it. It is alpha software and an experimental Emacs replacement, not a drop-in GNU Emacs substitute; keep GNU Emacs installed for rollback.

use.flag: Enable the winit/wgpu graphical display engine (always built)
Enable the embedded terminal emulator feature
Support the dev-libs/tree-sitter parsing library (always built)
